purpose: Reconcile first-party Claus Web customer/billing evidence with the first-party controller/site-ownership determination without conflating domain ownership, billing, hosting-account access or GDPR roles.

documentary_facts.fact: Authenticated first-party user determination fixes EUROCONSULT SRL as GDPR controller for AI4WORK research and owner of eucons.ro.
Controlled Claus Web correspondence dated 2026-03-20 billed the eucons.ro domain-renewal transaction to FUNDAȚIA ANTREPRENORIAT SOCIAL.
Controlled Claus Web correspondence dated 2026-03-20 billed the eucons.ro deleted-hosting-account restoration transaction to FUNDAȚIA ANTREPRENORIAT SOCIAL.

A controlled Claus Web password-reset message dated 2026-08-13 lists separate customer accounts for EUROCONSULT SRL and FUNDAȚIA ANTREPRENORIAT SOCIAL, so customer-account existence alone does not establish which current account carries the eucons.ro live hosting service.

reconciliation.conclusion: The March 2026 billing/restoration evidence is compatible with EUROCONSULT SRL owning eucons.ro and acting as controller, because billing/account administration is not equivalent to domain ownership or controller status. It also means the live processing chain cannot be considered verified until the current service-to-account mapping and access/instruction scope are read back.

claim_boundaries: Do not infer that FUNDAȚIA ANTREPRENORIAT SOCIAL is a controller or joint controller from billing/restoration evidence.
Do not infer that EUROCONSULT SRL's separate Claus Web customer account carries the current eucons.ro hosting service merely because that account exists.
Do not infer current respondent-level, log, backup or database access for either customer account without account-specific evidence.
Do not expose private client IDs, password-reset links, invoice tokens, credentials, addresses or personal-contact data in repository artifacts.
required_before_prod: read back which current Claus Web service/account carries the eucons.ro AI4WORK endpoint and research-only store
bind EUROCONSULT SRL controller instructions to the actual processor/service chain
verify who can access cPanel Raw Access logs, research-only storage, backup and deletion controls
verify account-specific Annex 5 overrides, if any
reconcile the verified live path with the dedicated AI4WORK Article 13 notice and public privacy surface
